title: SAFFIRE-I large-scale cotton/fiberglass flame-spread measurements

flow_direction_definition.concurrent: flow in the same direction as flame spread

gravity_comparison.earth: The paper mentions a ground comparison, but these two records are microgravity-only.

transcription_notes: Only two explicitly stated mean spread-rate values are included; no curve points have been digitized or estimated.

Missing values are null and do not mean zero.
